title: 18033 - 18033/P1625/005669
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Transmission Control Module (J217) faulty
stepByStepSolution:
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Transmission Control Module (J217)
Kontrol edin:  Measuring Value Block (MVB) 125+
technicalNotes: This Fault Code is stored in case of Communication Problems with the Transmission Control Module (J217).
